about: Where the items ForeverDB's data gives no source come from, read in QuestieDB (https://github.com/Questie/QuestieDB, GPL-3.0) by _build/questie.py and laid over the data by _build/corrections.py. Sources are written as ForeverDB writes them, with the label t; "at" is the instance a quest or a creature belongs to, or "boss" for a raid boss QuestieDB does not place. Written by `python build.py --import-questie`: do not edit.
